Name: Aggregate/Sum/amount/By/region/Where/category
Maps: from d in docs.Aggregates select new { region = d.region, category = d.category, value = (long)d.amount }
Reduce: from r in results group r by new { r.region, r.category } into g select new { region = g.Key.region, category = g.Key.category, value = g.Sum(x => (long)x.value) }
